claim_ceiling: a second, independent draw of 300 objectives for each of the 40 certification fixed rows, under the same frozen fits and the same policies field for field. It is a certification, not a selection: no row was re-chosen and no knob was re-derived here. Its ceiling is that 40 rows over 16 seed-domain clusters still do not make an unconditional guarantee -- the seed is the resampling unit, the cluster intervals are wide, and this run says nothing about equal-cost superiority (C3) or about which part of the correction does the work (C4).
